target.statement: Correction-level F1 of BERT-Corrector trained on MCSCSet (80.49%)

compute.basis: Training BERT-base on 157k samples for 20 epochs with batch size 64 requires GPU; on CPU it would take days, so the target is not feasible on a normal laptop within a few hours.

blockers: Training BERT-base on 157k samples for 20 epochs is computationally heavy and not feasible on CPU within a few hours.
The paper does not provide training code or pre-trained model weights; only the dataset is released.
Requires downloading and setting up a Chinese BERT model (e.g., from HuggingFace) and implementing the training pipeline from scratch.
title: MCSCSet: A Specialist-annotated Dataset for Medical-domain Chinese Spelling Correction
